definitions.explanation: The oily substance secreted by glands in the skin. It keeps skin and hair moisturized but can also clog pores.

examples.japanese: {皮脂|ひし}が{多|おお}い{肌|はだ}。
examples.english: Skin with a lot of sebum.

examples.japanese: {鼻|はな}のまわりは{皮脂|ひし}が{出|で}やすい。
examples.english: Sebum is easily produced around the nose.

examples.japanese: {皮脂|ひし}が{毛穴|けあな}に{詰|つ}まると、ニキビの{原因|げんいん}になる。
examples.english: When sebum clogs the pores, it can cause acne.

notes:
The oil naturally secreted by the skin. A common term in skincare and cosmetics contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皮脂|ひし}が{出|で}る: for sebum to be secreted
- {皮脂|ひし}を{抑|おさ}える: to control sebum
- {皮脂|ひし}{腺|せん}: sebaceous gland

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脂|あぶら}: oil; fat — the general word; {皮脂|ひし} is specifically skin oil
- {汗|あせ}: sweat — also secreted by the skin, but watery and from different glands
